notes: Nine localized open–close interaction episodes are visible. The pantry front appears articulated and is treated as one coupled manipulation episode. The bedroom entry-door closure is partly obscured by camera repositioning, so its off time has lower confidence.
scene_description: A first-person traversal through an apartment kitchen, living/dining area, utility and laundry closets, and a bedroom. Interactions consist primarily of opening and later closing appliance, drawer, cabinet, and closet doors.
